title: Analytics Engineer
description:
New York or Arlington (Hybrid, 3 days onsite) Base: $80,000 - $130,000 + Share Options




The Company:

Stream is on a mission to bring financial wellbeing to all workers.




We partner with some of the world's most well-known employers, like Crate & Barrel, Driven Brands, General Electric, New Balance, Restaurant Brands International (RBI) and others, to give their teams access to fairer financial services. Over 3 million people track their shifts and earnings, start their first savings account, use budgeting tools, access financial education and choose when they want to get paid. All in one smartphone app.




Stream is unique: VC-backed and growing at scale-up pace, but with a social conscience. Some of the world's leading financial charities and impact funds were our founding investors.

You'd be joining a team of over 300 passionate, ambitious people across the UK, Europe and US, building a category-leading FinTech product with the mission to improve the lives of millions.




The role

You will be the second data person dedicated to the US business, working alongside our Lead Data Engineer in the US and as part of the central Data team. The US has grown significantly and just launched its largest customer to date. That growth creates real demand for analysis: commercial teams want to quantify customer ROI, product wants to understand adoption across multiple US products, and finance, compliance and state regulators need accurate, reproducible reporting.




This is an analytics engineering role in the full sense. You model data in dbt, you build the dashboards and data apps people use in StreamBI, and you sit with business stakeholders to turn a vague question into a defined analysis. You own a business area end to end rather than handing work between an analyst and an engineer.




What you will work on

Customer ROI Program: Partner with our US GTM and implementation teams on the data side of a new client-facing programme: define what data we ask customers for, what the minimum viable extract is, how it lands securely, and then run the repeatable analyses that show clients the impact Stream has on turnover, retention and absenteeism.
US commercial and product analytics. Build the adoption, engagement and cohort analysis on top of our per-product usage layer, and give the commercial team a validated set of statistics they can put in front of prospects.
Regulatory and financial reporting. Take over execution of our state regulatory reports and examiner follow-ups using the scaffolded pipeline we have built, and extend our financial integrity checks across US salary and settlement data.
Dashboards and data apps. Build and maintain US dashboards in StreamBI, our Streamlit-based BI platform, replacing legacy Redash and Sigma reporting.
Shared responsibilities. Around a fifth of your time goes to the things every analytics engineer here does: triaging dbt and data quality alerts, answering questions in #ask-data, reviewing PRs across our dbt and StreamBI repos, and keeping documentation current.




Within six months you should own the US commercial analytics domain outright, be running state regulatory reports without supervision, and be the first person US stakeholders think to ask.




Key technologies

SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Python, Streamlit, GitHub, Claude Code




What we are looking for

Two to four years in analytics engineering, or in a data analyst role where you built and owned the models as well as the outputs.
Strong SQL, including the discipline to reconcile numbers and prove they tie out, not just aggregate them.
Hands-on dbt experience, and the ability to read and extend a dimensional model without breaking its grain.
Python sufficient to build data apps in Streamlit, or a clear track record of picking up a similar framework fast.
Experience working directly with commercial or operational stakeholders: taking an ambiguous request, redefining it, and returning something that changed a decision.
Comfortable using agentic coding tools day to day. Claude Code is part of how this team works, not an add-on.
Able to operate independently in your timezone, decide what an analysis should be, and push back on a stakeholder when the data does not support the ask.




Nice to have: experience producing outputs for regulators, auditors or clients where being wrong had consequences; exposure to payroll, HR tech, payments or fintech data.




What will we do for you?

15 Days vacation in addition to federal holidays, as well as flexible time off allowances for any ad-hoc childcare/family/caring needs
12 weeks paid Maternity Leave and 2 weeks paid Paternity Leave for employees with over 12 months service
Health, dental and vision benefits (a number of these benefits are paid in full for the employee)
We want to invest in you financially, so we have a 401K program




And of course, the best benefit of all, access to Stream!




At Stream we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Stream is an equal opportunity workplace. We are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, or veteran status.

title: Sr. Analytics Data Platform Engineer
description:
Who We Are

DV is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners Verify the quality of their digital campaigns, Optimise to improve performance and Prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, agencies, publishers, and digital ad platforms. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com.

About The Role

Role Overview

You will join the Data & Analytics Platform (DAP) team within the Pinnacle engineering organization. The DAP team owns and operates two data consolidation platforms — Quantum (contract-driven, next-gen) and Analytics 2.0 (SQL-driven, legacy) — that ingest, transform, and serve billions of records daily from social platforms, measurement systems, and third-party partners. The data powers Looker dashboards, customer-facing reports, and downstream APIs used across DoubleVerify's product suite.

What You'll Do


Platform Abstraction & Design: Design and maintain the YAML-based "Contract" system that allows users to define data entities, transformations, and SLOs without writing low-level orchestration code.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop the translation engine that converts user contracts into automated dbt models, Airflow DAGs, and Snowflake objects.
API Development: Transition the platform from static configuration files to a dynamic, API-first architecture, enabling programmatic creation of data artifacts.
Self-Service Enablement: Build tooling and guardrails that allow business units to deploy their own data solutions while maintaining global standards for governance and security.
Performance & Scale: Optimize the "translation" layer to ensure that generated jobs are efficient, cost-effective, and leverage the full power of the Snowflake/dbt stack.
Developer Experience (DevEx): Act as the "Product Manager" for your platform, gathering feedback from internal users to simplify the data development lifecycle.
Design and build data pipelines that process billions of records a day across consolidation, semantic, and externalization layers using the DV Internal Data Platform — a self-service, contract-driven architecture where pipelines are defined via YAML contracts and automatically deployed to Snowflake, Airflow, and Looker.
Develop and extend the Contract Interpreter — a Python library (Pydantic, Jinja2) that reads contract driven platform based YAML and generates dbt models, Airflow DAGs, and environment configurations for each deployment environment (dev, stg, prod).
Lead new initiatives and integrations with the world's largest social platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Reddit, Netflix, etc.) to measure ad performance end-to-end.
Build and maintain the semantic layer — design LookML models, explores, and views that translate consolidated data into customer-ready analytics through Looker.
Implement and maintain observability — build monitoring, alerting, watermarking, and data consistency checks to ensure pipeline reliability and data freshness at scale.
Leverage AI agents and tooling — contribute to and use the team's AI agent workspace (meta-repo with AGENTS.md context files, skills, and MCP integrations) to accelerate development, automate workflows, and encode institutional knowledge for AI-assisted engineering.
Design schema evolution and data migration strategies — manage schema versioning, backward compatibility, incremental vs. full-refresh deployments, and large-scale data backfills.
Work in multi-functional agile teams with end-to-end responsibility for product development and delivery — from contract definition to customer-facing data.
Collaborate directly with engineers from partner platforms on API development and data integration specifications.
Train and mentor a team of software engineers.


Who You Are

Required Experience & Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in a Data Engineering or related role.
Strong SQL skills — advanced querying, performance tuning, window functions, and complex transformations at scale.
Proficiency in Python — building libraries, data processing scripts, and automation tooling (experience with Pydantic, Jinja2, or similar templating frameworks is a plus).
Deep experience with Snowflake — schema design, Snowpipe, streams, tasks, materialized views, clustering, and query optimization.
Experience with dbt (data build tool) — building and maintaining models, macros, custom materializations, and incremental strategies.
Experience with orchestration tools — Airflow / Cloud Composer, DAG design, scheduling, and monitoring.
Experience with cloud platforms — GCP (GCS, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Kubernetes) or equivalent.
Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts — dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, fact/aggregate table design, and data consistency patterns.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines — GitLab CI, Flyway migrations, or similar deployment automation.
Experience with AI-assisted development tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI coding assistants. Experience building or contributing to AI agent context files (AGENTS.md), skills, or meta-repo patterns is a strong plus


Preferred Experience & Qualifications


Experience building or working with contract-driven / configuration-driven data platforms where pipelines are generated from declarative specifications (YAML, JSON schemas).
Experience with Looker / LookML — building semantic models, exploring, aggregating awareness, and dashboard development.
Experience with Kafka — schema registries, topic management, and streaming data integration.
Experience with data quality and observability frameworks — automated testing, watermarking, data integrity validation, and SLA monitoring.
Experience with Terraform or infrastructure-as-code for managing cloud resources.
Familiarity with data mesh principles — federated data ownership, data products, and self-service platform design.

Brown Advisory is seeking a Senior Integration Engineer to design, build, enhance, and support system-to-system integrations across the firm’s Wealth and Asset Management technology ecosystem. This hands-on engineering role focuses on developing APIs, data pipelines, platform integrations, and automation solutions that enable secure, reliable, and scalable movement of investment and operational data across strategic business platforms.

Working closely with engineering, business, investment operations, data, and vendor teams, the Senior Integration Engineer will design and implement integration solutions supporting platforms including Addepar, Snowflake, Canoe, portfolio management systems, client reporting platforms, and other enterprise applications. The role combines strong technical engineering skills with an understanding of wealth and asset management business processes to deliver high-quality production solutions that improve operational efficiency, data quality, and business capabilities.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Overview

The Senior Analyst, Client Analytics develops insights that help pharmaceutical manufacturer clients understand program performance, prescription trends, and the patient journey. This role partners closely with Client/Account Management, Operations, Data Engineering and other teams to turn complex data into actionable insights that strengthen client relationships and drive program performance.

Collaborative, curious, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.
Blink Health is transforming how Americans access affordable prescription medications.

title: Senior Analyst, Insights & Analytics
description:

Our Marketing & Patient Solutions group creates and delivers human-centered experiences, where innovation meets customer-centricity, driving the ultimate experience for our patients. Our focus extends beyond transactions to craft experiences as one fully integrated, aligned and connected organization that puts empathy at the center, powered by insight and foresight. Do you get excited about exploring the unknown? Does the idea of driving value through human-centered design pull you in? Are you ready to experiment with us?

The Position

The Senior Analyst, Insights & Analytics – Rare Disease serves as the primary day-to-day commercial analytics partner for assigned U.S. Rare Endocrine Disorders (RED) workstreams, with an initial focus on growth hormone deficiency (GHD).

The Senior Analyst independently owns defined analytical workstreams from business-question framing through execution, interpretation, communication, and follow-through. The role delivers secondary analytics that inform brand strategy, launch and in-market performance, customer and account opportunity, business reviews, and commercial decisions. Working within priorities established by the Director and shared portfolio standards, the Senior Analyst maintains direct stakeholder relationships and is accountable for timely, accurate, and decision-relevant outputs within the assigned scope.

A core responsibility is applying and advancing AI-enabled analytics within assigned workstreams. The Senior Analyst identifies practical use cases and develops or prototypes approved automation, custom GPT/LLM-based assistants, agentic workflows, natural-language analytics, and self-service capabilities that improve speed, consistency, accessibility, or quality while maintaining appropriate validation, governance, and human review.

The Senior Analyst partners with primary market research and specialized analytics functions to integrate relevant evidence into a coherent commercial perspective. The role also contributes to shared Rare Disease methods, data assets, and scalable capabilities when assigned, without displacing primary RED/GHD accountability.

Relationships

This role reports to the Director of U.S. Rare Disease Insights & Analytics and serves as the primary day-to-day analytics partner for assigned RED workstreams, including GHD.

The Senior Analyst builds direct working relationships with Product Directors, Commercial Leadership, Sales Leadership, Forecasting, Finance, Medical Affairs, global insights partners, Enterprise Insights & Analytics, data and technology teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders. For assigned workstreams, the Senior Analyst independently clarifies business questions, aligns analytical plans and timelines, communicates findings, and follows through on agreed actions. Material priority, capacity, resource, stakeholder, or business-risk decisions are escalated to the Director.

The Senior Analyst collaborates with the Manager on shared methodologies, portfolio standards, AI-enabled capabilities, cross-portfolio dependencies, and quality review for high-impact priorities. The Director sets team priorities, resolves material resource tradeoffs, and retains performance-management and development accountability. The Senior Analyst remains a direct report to the Director and owns assigned analytical workstreams and deliverables end to end.

The Senior Analyst works with the designated primary market research lead and with Field Analytics, Market Access Analytics, and Patient Analytics to coordinate business questions and integrate relevant outputs. Those functions retain accountability for their respective analytics strategies, methodologies, and deliverables.

Externally, the Senior Analyst may work with data providers, analytics vendors, consultants, and technology partners on defined projects, including scope coordination, quality review, documentation, and delivery.

Essential Functions

Rare Endocrine Analytics Ownership & Business Partnership


Independently owns defined analytics workstreams supporting RED, including GHD, from business-question framing through recommendation and follow-through.
Translates strategic and operational business questions into clear hypotheses, analytical objectives, methods, deliverables, and decision criteria.
Develops and manages workplans, milestones, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations for assigned analyses and recurring deliverables.
Maintains direct stakeholder relationships for assigned workstreams and proactively identifies emerging questions, risks, and opportunities.
Balances recurring and ad hoc priorities in alignment with the Director; escalates material capacity, scope, or timing conflicts with recommended tradeoffs and coordinates shared methodology or cross-portfolio dependencies with the Manager.
Retains accountability for the accuracy, completeness, interpretation, documentation, and timely delivery of assigned analytical outputs.



Commercial Analytics & Business Performance Insights


Integrates and analyzes relevant claims, specialty pharmacy, prescriber, account, product, sales, and other commercial data within the assigned RED/GHD analytics scope.
Develops KPI frameworks, measurement plans, scorecards, and analytical approaches that connect commercial strategy with measurable outcomes.
Conducts analytics supporting launch readiness and tracking, in-market performance, prescriber and account dynamics, customer opportunity, and other commercial performance questions.
Leads preparation of recurring RED/GHD business-performance reviews, translating complex data into clear perspectives on trends, drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
Performs prescriber-, account-, product-, and market-level analyses to identify adoption patterns, performance drivers, and commercial opportunities.
Conducts rapid-response and ad hoc analyses for emerging questions, unexpected performance changes, and leadership priorities.
Partners with Forecasting and other functions to connect observed performance and analytical findings with planning assumptions and business discussions.
Ensures conclusions reflect Rare Disease data limitations, including small and concentrated populations, data lag, coverage gaps, longitudinal inconsistency, and uncertainty.



Reporting, Data Quality & Self-Service Analytics


Develops, enhances, and maintains dashboards, scorecards, and reporting tools that provide stakeholders with timely and decision-relevant information.
Applies consistent business definitions, calculation logic, refresh schedules, documentation, and quality controls across assigned deliverables.
Investigates data discrepancies, documents root causes, and coordinates resolution with appropriate data owners and enterprise partners.
Identifies opportunities to simplify recurring reporting, eliminate duplicative work, and automate repeatable analytical processes.
Builds reusable data assets, templates, and self-service capabilities that improve consistency and create capacity for higher-value analysis.
Monitors stakeholder adoption and usefulness of analytics products and recommends improvements based on business needs and feedback.



AI-Enabled Analytics, Automation & Innovation

Develops or prototypes approved automation, custom GPT/LLM assistants, agentic workflows, natural-language analytics, and data-connected workflows using authorized platforms.
Connects data to approved workflows and tests, validates, documents, and monitors AI-supported outputs with human review and analytical accountability.
Partners with the Manager and appropriate enterprise governance functions to support compliant implementation.
Creates reusable guidance and supports adoption of approved AI-enabled and self-service capabilities by analysts and authorized stakeholders.
Measures impact through cycle time, analytical capacity, quality, consistency, adoption, and decision support and recommends whether capabilities should be refined or scaled.



Integrated Insights, Communication & Capability Building

Develops leadership-ready presentations that distinguish evidence, interpretation, implications, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
Communicates complex methods, limitations, and findings in accessible business language for commercial and cross-functional audiences.

Experience

The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

The Role

As an Applied AI Data Analyst, you will bridge the gap between our massive, unstructured financial and operational datasets to our core R&D team. You will own the evaluation platform of our agentic workflows forecasting pipelines, as well as improve customer facing insights leading to mission-critical decisions.

This role is part of the Applied AI Research department, with options to advance to senior data science and AI/ML engineering roles.

Location: New York, NY (In-Person | Relocation supported)

What you'll do


Algorithm & LLM Evaluation: Analyze edge cases, model predictions, hallucination rates, and extraction accuracy for our LLM-driven document processing systems and agentic workflows.
Root Cause Analysis: Dig deep into complex datasets (inconsistent financial documents, fragmented enterprise systems) to determine why an extraction or time-series model succeeded or failed.
Golden Dataset Curation: Define, curate, and maintain gold-standard evaluation datasets ("golden sets") for automated backtesting of AI agents and demand forecasting models.
Performance Monitoring & Evals: Build dashboards, data transformations, and evaluation harnesses to monitor system health, model drift, and AI performance metrics across release cycles.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with applied AI engineers, product managers and business operations managers to turn qualitative real-world problem definitions into quantitative product defining insights.


What we're looking for

Required


Education: Graduate degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or a related STEM field.
Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a quantitative data analyst or AI evaluation role, working closely alongside AI/ML R&D teams.
Programming & Agentic AI: Proficiency in Python and hands-on works with AI/ML models
Data Stack: Strong capabilities with SQL and enterprise data infrastructure (PostgreSQL, Snowflake, dbt, AWS).
Analytical Mindset: Exceptional ability to translate noisy, unstructured document data into rigorous evaluation insights for engineers.


Nice to have


Experience with LLM observability, tracing, and eval frameworks (LangSmith, Arize AI, or TruLens).
Proficiency with agentic workflows or multi-agent orchestration.
Familiarity with demand forecasting, time-series models, or statistical modeling.
Comfort in fast-moving, high-growth NYC startup environments.

Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
